name: Combat Sports Conjugate 2-Day
description: Westside-style upper/lower strength for wrestlers, grapplers, boxers and MMA fighters, two days a week: a max-effort and a speed lift each day, neck, grip, hip and trunk work, and one short power finisher - the mat builds the gas tank. Same 12-week test calendar as the club.
